meta.name: short-drama-edit
meta.description: 将已生成的短剧镜头剪成成片，记录入出点、镜序、声音、字幕与交付规格。用于套剪、加字幕、统一响度、调整节奏或导出精修素材；需要补素材或修改故事时转回对应创作阶段。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把零散镜头剪成有字幕、声音统一的成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有一堆短剧素材要剪成能直接交付的成片
copy.tagline_en: Turn scattered shots into a finished short drama with subtitles and even audio
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a pile of short-drama footage to cut into a deliverable film

howto.what: 把「剧集/<EP>/制作成果/」里的逐镜素材装配成一条成片：先写出 剪辑单.md，记录每段入出点、镜序、声音、字幕与交付规格，再渲染成片并做可测项验收。
howto.when: 当「剧集/<EP>/制作成果/」里已存在可打开的视频文件，你需要套剪、加字幕、统一响度等剪辑成片时接管；提示词写完或 job 成功不算素材可用。

say.text: 用 short-drama-edit 把 EP001 已生产的镜头剪成成片
say.note: 先产出剪辑单，再渲染成片

say.text: 给 EP001 的成片烧上字幕并统一响度
say.note: 字幕逐字取自剧本原文

say.text: 检查 EP001 剪辑单的区间和素材是否自洽

howto.what_en: Assembles the per-shot footage in 剧集/<EP>/制作成果/ into one finished cut: it first writes 剪辑单.md recording each segment's in/out points, shot order, sound, subtitles and delivery specs, then renders the cut and verifies measurable items.
howto.when_en: Triggers when readable video files already exist in 剧集/<EP>/制作成果/ and you need to cut, subtitle, or level a finished episode; a finished prompt or a successful job does not count as usable footage.

say_en.text: Use short-drama-edit to cut EP001's produced shots into a finished cut
say_en.note: Writes the cut list first, then renders

say_en.text: Burn subtitles onto EP001's cut and match the target loudness
say_en.note: Subtitle text comes from the script

say_en.text: Check whether EP001's cut list intervals and footage are consistent
say_en.note: check only inspects, it does not render
